sources.title: Making an application
sources.role: MHCLG planning practice guidance on application types and validation.
sources.facts: Current guidance covers full and outline permission, reserved matters, conditions, amendments, lawful development certificates and prior approval.
sources.origin: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.
sources.guard: Application guidance or registration does not prove validation, permission, ownership, condition discharge or implementation.

sources.title: Planning appeals procedural guide for applications dated on or after 1 April 2026
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate guide for the post-1-April-2026 appeal process.
sources.facts: Published 12 February 2026; updated 16 July 2026; explains rights, time limits, procedures and decisions.
sources.guard: An appeal route or submitted appeal does not prove acceptance, merits, costs award or successful outcome.

sources.title: Planning appeals procedural guide for applications dated on or before 31 March 2026
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate guide for the earlier application cohort.
sources.facts: Published 6 April 2015; updated 16 July 2026; covers responsibilities, procedures, amendments, evidence and decisions.
sources.guard: Procedural guidance does not prove an appeal was made on time, evidence is accepted or permission will be granted.

sources.title: Enforcement appeals: procedural guide
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate enforcement appeal procedure guidance.
sources.facts: Published 6 March 2014; updated 22 April 2026; explains parties, timetables, procedures and decision publication.
sources.guard: An enforcement appeal or guide does not suspend every notice, prove immunity, establish lawfulness or predict the decision.

sources.title: Certificate of lawful use or development appeals: procedural guide
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate LDC appeal procedure guidance.
sources.facts: Published 30 June 2014; updated 20 May 2026; explains timetables, evidence, procedures and decisions.
sources.guard: An LDC application or appeal does not prove the use or development is lawful until a valid final decision supports it.

sources.title: Make an appeal to the Planning Inspectorate and associated guidance
sources.role: Official collection for planning, enforcement, LDC and related appeal routes.
sources.facts: Current collection includes planning, enforcement, listed building, advertisement, CIL, S106 and called-in case guidance.
sources.guard: A collection or digital route does not prove jurisdiction, completeness, acceptance or the substantive result of a case.

sources.title: New digital service becomes the primary route for planning and enforcement appeals
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate operational update on appeal submission services.
sources.facts: Published 16 April 2026; identifies supported appeal types and the primary digital submission route.
sources.guard: Service availability or a submission receipt does not prove a valid appeal, complete evidence or successful decision.

sources.title: Appeals planning practice guidance
sources.role: MHCLG planning practice guidance on appeal types, time limits and documents.
sources.facts: Current revision dated 2 April 2026; summarises appeal deadlines and required application documents.
sources.origin: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.
sources.guard: General appeal guidance does not establish the deadline, validity or outcome for a specific case without its facts and decision notice.
